title: Justice Department says North Koreans have infiltrated dozens of U.S. companies | TechCrunch
summary: CrowdStrike, which helped the FBI investigate and disrupt the latest North Korean operations, said that laptop farms are “vital” to North Korea in helping its hackers overcome physical, financial, and legal challenges of not physically being in the United States.
